title: SSH private keys from 1Password are read but not passed to PuTTY
author: cremenescu
body_snippet: When an SSH connection takes its credentials from 1Password, `PuttyBase` calls `OnePasswordCli.ReadPassword`, which also returns the private key from the item's SSH key field (`OnePasswordCli.ItemGet`), and then does nothing with it. For Delinea Secret Server and Passwordstate, `PuttyBase` writes the key to a temporary `.ppk` file (`WriteTemporaryPrivateKeyFile`) and passes it to PuTTY with `-i`.
